subject: Founder voucher stacking, invoice split & conversion addendum
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@seedforge.vc>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nebulalabs.com, legal@nebulalabs.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Founder grant + trial stacking — need invoice split and tax note

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Nebula is excited to run the founder cohort on Redwood. A couple of operational questions came up while we pulled documents together:

- The founders in our cohort each have a one-time "founder voucher" from SeedForge (internal voucher codes). Can we stack those against the 90-day beta trial that Redwood offered, or do they need to be applied sequentially?
- For accounting, procurement needs two invoices: one reflecting the post-discount committed seats (what we pay now) and a second contingent invoice / credit note that captures any conversion credit if we hit the 3-month usage milestone. Is that something Redwood can produce?
- Tax treatment: our finance team needs a short paragraph confirming whether unused voucher dollars are treated as a promotional credit (non-taxable in our jurisdiction) or if they will be invoiced then credited back.

I've attached the SeedForge agreement and a usage export from our internal trial tracking so you can see expected consumption patterns. We aim to close the procurement flow this week.

Attachments: SeedForge-Founders-Agreement.pdf; usage-export-2026-08-01.csv

Thanks,
Samira Khan
SeedForge — Head, Programs
samira@seedforge.vc
+1 415-555-0192

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@seedforge.vc>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder grant + trial stacking — need invoice split and tax note

Samira — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) Stacking: We can allow stacking for this cohort as a one-off exception, provided the vouchers are single-use and redeemed before the trial end date. Operationally, vouchers will be redeemed first at time of sign-up and the beta trial credit will apply to remaining consumption.

2) Invoice split: We can issue an initial invoice for the committed seats (net of voucher redemption) and a contingent invoice schedule that will convert into a credit if Nebula hits the agreed milestone (3-month active usage > X tokens / seat). I will loop in Ben for a short legal/addendum for the conversion mechanics.

3) Tax note: We can provide a standard promo credit statement, but if Nebula requires a jurisdiction-specific tax opinion we will need the procurement/legal contact to confirm their country and VAT/GST details.

Actions:
- Ben, can you draft a short conversion addendum with the milestone and the 15% conversion credit language?
- Lauren, can ops produce the two-invoice template and confirm how redemption appears on the invoice line items?

Samira, if you can confirm the exact milestone metric (tokens or active seats) and the billing address / tax VAT number for Nebula, we'll produce the draft addendum and invoice sample by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Samira Khan <samira@seedforge.vc>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder grant + trial stacking — need invoice split and tax note

Kim / Samira — draft language attached. Key points I included:

- Definition: "Conversion Credit" equals 15% of cumulative paid usage in the first 90 days post-trial, payable as an invoice credit applied to the next billing cycle.
- Milestone: Conversion triggers when cohort average daily active seats >= 8 for 30 of 45 days within the 90-day window. (Samira: let me know if you want "tokens" instead.)
- Accounting flow: We will issue Invoice A (initial) for net-committed amount and Invoice B as an accrual/contingent memorandum that will be replaced by a credit memo if milestone met.
- Tax: We state that promotional vouchers are treated as contra-revenue for Redwood; Nebula's local tax treatment may differ and is their responsibility — recommend procurement/finance confirm.

I've attached a clean Word draft (conversion-addendum-draft.docx) with track-changes-friendly notes where legal might want to tighten definitions. Happy to iterate.

Attachments: conversion-addendum-draft.docx

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@seedforge.vc>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, procurement@nebulalabs.com, legal@nebulalabs.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 13:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder grant + trial stacking — need invoice split and tax note

Ben — this looks good and the milestone using "active seats" is preferable for us (tokens are noisy across projects). A couple of small asks before we route to Nebula legal: 

- Can the milestone threshold be expressed as cohort average (not median)? Our finance lead prefers averages for runway modeling.
- For the tax paragraph, could Redwood include a templated line we can paste into Nebula's purchasing doc that says: "Redwood treats promotional vouchers as contra-revenue; Nebula Labs should consult its local tax counsel for jurisdictional treatment" — that will speed procurement review.

If you can accept those two tweaks I can push this to Nebula legal and procurement today.

Thanks,
Samira

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@seedforge.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder grant + trial stacking — need invoice split and tax note

Samira — thanks. Ben and I synced and accepted both tweaks: cohort average is now explicit and we've added the templated tax disclosure line. Next steps: 

1) Ben will attach the revised addendum (final) and I will send both Invoice A and Invoice B sample files to procurement@nebulalabs.com.
2) Samira / Nebula legal to confirm VAT/tax ID and provide the exact billing address so we can populate Invoice A.
3) Once signed we will mark the vouchers as redeemable and insert the contingent Invoice B into Nebula's billing profile so the credit memo issues automatically if the milestone triggers.

I've also created a DocuSign envelope and will send the conversion addendum link to Samira and Nebula legal this afternoon: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/nebula-conversion-addendum

Thanks all — I will update the HubSpot deal when DocuSign is sent.

Best,
Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Invoice attachments to follow: Invoice-Split-Template.xlsx
